questions.title: Who will Aston Martin announce as Lance Stroll's teammate for the 2027 Formula One season?
questions.background: Aston Martin has not yet confirmed its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Aston Martin's official announcement confirming its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season, corroborated by Formula One or reputable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the driver named alongside Lance Stroll in the first such announcement published by December 31, 2026. A confirmed race-seat contract is sufficient; the driver need not have competed in a 2027 race. Reserve, test, and advisory roles do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The driver's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Updating on 2026-09-12 from GPblog (Aug 29-30), PlanetF1 (Sept 10 Madrid FIA press conference), and Sept 12 Spanish GP qualifying (Reuters/Arab News/Straits Times): Virtually all remaining external candidates are now off the 2027 grid—in addition to Verstappen (Red Bull), Norris (McLaren), Russell (Mercedes), and Sainz/Albon (Williams), GPblog confirms Sergio Perez (0.11 -> 0.04) remains on his multi-year Cadillac deal after no rival doors opened, and Oliver Bearman (0.06 -> 0.03) is locked in as Haas's 2027 team leader. GPblog also reports Aston Martin and Fernando Alonso are 'very likely to continue,' raising Alonso 0.55 -> 0.65. However, we cap Alonso at 0.65 (strict anti-overconfidence) because he explicitly told reporters in Madrid on Sept 10 that an announcement is 'not soon' ('no urgency'), is 45, and Aston Martin's 2026 car remains mired at the back (Alonso qualified P18 and Stroll P22/no time at Madrid today).
